title: Install matching kernel headers before hardware setup
author: spencerbull
body:
Fresh installs with `linux-omarchy` omitted its matching headers. On an XPS 14 installation, `linux-omarchy 7.2.5-3` was paired with stock `linux-headers 7.2.3.arch1-3`, so the camera package's DKMS hook skipped its modules and the camera failed after boot.

Install `<kernel>-headers` for each configured target kernel immediately after the base system, before hardware packages trigger DKMS. This also covers T2 and multiple-kernel configurations, in both full-disk and pre-mounted installs. The camera package is unchanged.

All fast shell checks and 66 Python tests passed. The regression test rejects the original behavior in all six kernel/layout cases. A local RC ISO was built and its embedded installer, package hashes, and checksum verified. In a disposable offline container, the matching `7.2.5-3` kernel/header pair allowed the existing `intel-ipu7-camera 1.0.6-1` package to install `intel-cvs`, IPU7 including PSYS, and `v4l2loopback` successfully.

Hardware camera/audio testing on the XPS with the locally built RC ISO is pending. The existing camera package still pulls unused stock Arch headers and logs missing-stock-kernel-tree errors; the required modules for the Omarchy kernel installed successfully in the container.
